summary:
Phase P2: make shared SearchEngine results truthful when a vector index contains orphan/stale entry ids.

Included mainline:
- Add a RED/GREEN Core regression where vector search returns both live and orphan entry ids while findByIdsDetailSync returns only the live database row.
- Filter semantic and hybrid/auto vector candidates against non-deprecated request-database rows before they can reach Search, Prime, ranking, or public projection. Preserve candidate order and scores for surviving live rows; refill up to the requested limit from over-retrieved live candidates when possible.
- Return a stable diagnostic/searchMeta signal or bounded count for filtered orphan vector candidates if the existing Core contract supports this without leaking provider internals; do not turn it into a readiness gate.
- Keep keyword/weighted behavior, vector fallback, filters, budgets, source-ref drift annotations, read-only database behavior, and existing SyncCoordinator reconciliation semantics unchanged.

Non-goals:
- Do not mutate or rebuild the live vector index during a query.
- Do not add Git revision/checkpoint, host-project, role/admin, intent, knowledge-state, or tool-visibility gates.
- Do not change Plugin MCP schemas, Graph, Recipe Map, Prime projection, Alembic main, vendor snapshots, or real project data in this package.

Boundary/dependency:
- Repository is AlembicCore; expected primary surface is src/service/search/SearchEngine.ts plus focused Core tests. AlembicPlugin integration waits for the accepted Core commit.

Validation and backfill:
- Commit the Core change in AlembicCore.
- Run focused SearchEngine tests, full Core test suite, npm run check, and npm run build.
- Return the commit, exact changed files/symbols, RED/GREEN orphan-vector proof, live-row ordering/limit proof, no-write proof, compatibility/failure-path review, command output summaries, and two-stage self-review.

Completion advances the demand to the Plugin consumer package; it does not complete the demand and does not dispatch Test.
sourceRef: User continuation command plus controller raw runtime/SQLite/code evidence on 2026-07-12.
designIntent: Use the request-scoped knowledge repository as the read-only truth set at the SearchEngine retrieval seam, filtering orphan vector candidates before ranking/projection rather than mutating the index or adding a policy gate.

continuation.reason: The user explicitly asked to continue resolving the quality problems discovered by controller real-tool acceptance. These are inside the existing five-tool retrieval-quality completion definition: semantic/Prime currently surface vector-index entries that the request-scoped knowledge database cannot retrieve; the same acceptance also proved Plugin Graph candidate preselection misses exact identifiers and Recipe Map misclassifies Core status=drifted as unresolved. The continuation preserves all prior accepted vector-default work and fixes only these evidenced truth/quality defects.

targetTasks.summary: Implement and commit Core SearchEngine filtering so orphan vector ids absent from the request-scoped knowledge database can never be returned as live knowledge; prove surviving live results keep ordering, budgets, filters, and read-only behavior.
